scheduled_maintenances.name: Codametrix Scheduled Maintenance Saturday February 7, 2026 9AM EST

incident_updates.body: The scheduled maintenance has been completed.
Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.
Maintenance will begin as scheduled in 60 minutes.

The CodaMetrix Platform will undergo scheduled maintenance Saturday, February 7th from 9AM EST until 12PM EST while we perform updates to our application database. This maintenance will result in a scheduled downtime of three hours.

CMX Automate Customers: Our interface servers will be down during the maintenance period.  CMX will neither be able to send or receive interface messages.  Outgoing messages (from CMX) will be held on our servers and released once the maintenance cycle is complete.  Customers should expect messages to queue (and possibly alert) on their end until our interface servers are back online.

CMX Amplify Customers: The application will be up during the maintenance period and available for coding.  However, both inbound and outbound messages will be held during this time.  Any new activity seen in Ampify will be limited to what was “inflight” at the beginning of the maintenance window. 

If you would like to be added to the email notification list for CodaMetrix's maintenance and incident updates, please visit status.codametrix.com and click "Subscribe to Updates."

We will update you via email an hour before the start time, at start time, and after the system has been restored. If you have any questions or need assistance, as always, please contact CodaMetrix support via our support portal or at support@codametrix.com.

scheduled_maintenances.name: Codametrix Platform Maintenance

incident_updates.body: The scheduled maintenance has been completed.
Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.

Codametrix will be performing maintenance on our vpn appliance and interface server on Saturday, September 20th. This work will result in up to 3 hours of downtime for certain parts of the platform.

Automate Customers:
Incoming messages will be held at your interface servers for the duration of the downtime. Outgoing messages will be held on our side.

Amplify Customers:
Coding will be possible, however charges will not send to Epic until the end of the downtime

We will send status updates via email one hour before the start, at the beginning of maintenance, and once the platform is fully back online.

If you have any questions or need assistance, please contact Codametrix Support through our support portal or email us at support@codametrix.com
